class.name: JarRepeatSdf
class.brief_description: Repeats its child field on a grid.
class.description: Copies are [member spacing] apart and centered on the origin. A [member count] of [code]0[/code] on an axis repeats forever along it (the field is then unbounded and cannot be used with [method JarVoxelVolume.edit]). For exact distances the child should fit inside one cell.

members.member: Number of copies along each axis; [code]0[/code] means infinite.
Distance between copies along each axis.
